ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes and 20% low-intensity black pixels localized at the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region dominated by a contiguous white field; peripheral black banding along the entire trailing edge. Notable discrete low-intensity circular clusters (black spots) at mid-left lobe coordinates. Diffuse yellow-tan intensity gradients in the lower-central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle approximately 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis of the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-12 pixels, appearing most jagged and irregular at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex posterior trajectory on both lobes tapering into sharp, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity white circular objects (barnacles) located on the distal trailing edges. Circular 'ghost' rings visible on the upper right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the central-right and lower-left white quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both lobes; visible physical indentations along the trailing edge serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct high-contrast black focal spots in the lower-left white field; significant yellowish bio-film staining across the lower medial surfaces.
